checks.description: Compiled size types accept exactly 16,20,24,28,32,40,56,120 and reject other sizes.
Omitted size resolves to 40 and omitted activityRing resolves to false.
Image wins over initials and icon; initials wins over icon; ambiguous supplied modes warn once per render policy while rendering only the winner.
Trim/uppercase strings and numbers, truncate to one character at 16 and two otherwise; empty initials default to AB.
Absent image and initials render the default person icon, with decorative default root semantics.

tests.name: Avatar renders the default icon fallback as a decorative image avatar

checks.description: Circular root retains ring plus exactly the selected image, icon or initials; user style follows every component style and root ref targets the View.
Image uses cover resizing, absolute fill and zero root padding with transparent background at size 56.

tests.name: Avatar renders the image full bleed without avatar padding

checks.description: All eight sizes resolve documented diameter/padding, icon 12/16/16/16/20/24/32/48 dimensions, initials font sizes and functional regular foreground without inherited body lineHeight.
Initials remain absolutely centered without edge offsets; native scaling and explicit caller line metrics survive at smallest/largest sizes without clipping.
Review glyph ink, image crop and circular/ring geometry at all sizes with scaling on Windows, Win32 and macOS.
Labeled initials avatar exposes one accessible image with the supplied identity.

tests.name: Avatar renders informative avatars with the image role and label

checks.description: Unlabeled root hides descendants; explicit accessible override is honored; image/icon/initials and activity ring stay decorative in every mode.
UIA/AX reads informative identity once, omits decorative avatars and never announces ring visibility as status or focus.
Forward broad ViewProps, native ref and caller focusable without adding hover, press, disabled, selected or focus state.
Default identity adds no Tab stop or ring; containing control owns pointer/keyboard activation and status meaning; content changes have no animation.

For every size and content mode, ring exists initially with border color/width/gap and pointerEvents none; false/true/false changes only opacity and preserves native View identity, root dimensions and absence of outline properties.
At size 120 active ring uses thick gap plus thicker stroke outside unchanged 120px root bounds.

tests.name: Avatar renders the active ring without changing layout size

checks.description: Initially active and toggled rings render without Fabric outline fail-fast, hit-target growth or accessibility/focus changes.

limitations: Focusable is deliberately forwarded although identity-only usage should remain unfocusable; the contract records this as deferred.
Parameterized assertions were read but no expanded Jest identities are guessed; unlinked matrix checks remain visible.
Native line metrics, Fabric safety, optical alignment and UIA/AX announcements require renderer-specific evidence, not flattened unit styles.
